subject: Re: 🔵{Brand} & MobUpps
body:
Hi RECIPIENT_NAME,
Circling back on my earlier email about reactivating churned bettors in your licensed states. One number reframes the win-back case: 27% of churned players reactivate on day one and recovery decays fast, so the 0 to 14 day window is where reload and loss-back outreach actually lands. Cost per qualified bettor in US regulated markets runs $50 to $300, which is exactly where deposit-event screening and incrementality decide your real cost. We hold out a control group so recovered redeposits read as incremental to organic returns. Worth comparing to your current mix?
angle: fresh angle: day-1 reactivation peak and 0-14 day win-back window (Optimove, sourced) + market CPA band (track360)
register_notes: Stage 2 EN sports_betting retargeting: acknowledges the second follow-up and references the prior outreach in the first sentence; fresh angle = the descending recovery curve (27% day-1 reactivation, fast decay, 0-14 day win-back window; web-verified via Optimove) paired with the real market CPA band $50 to $300 (web-verified via track360); MobUpps holdout/incrementality reference carries no figure; market context is sourced in enrichment_sources and never attributed to MobUpps; one question mark; no new brands introduced; native US register; no sign-off; no em-dash; no X, not Y.
